notes.title: Discover Dark Fracture, a new kind of psychological horror adventure
notes.notes:
Feardemic is proud to announce the next generation of terror: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268790/Dark_Fracture/][b]Dark Fracture[/b][/url], a psychological first-person horror adventure game in which jump scares are the least concerning occurrences that the players will be facing.

The game is developed by the indie team Twisted II Studio and will be released in 2022 on PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.

[h2]About the game
[/h2]
Set in the late 90s in a forested area of the Northeastern USA, Dark Fracture brings you into the eerie environment of a body farm – a decomposition research facility. You enter the world as Edward, a lonely individual tormented by a tragic past, whose only solace is in the medicine that helps him to get through the day. Edward is barely able to cope with his issues, which are only intensified by the solitude of his workplace. He puts on a brave front and dutifully wakes up for work every day. His routine serves as his only anchor, but deep inside, trouble is simmering...

If you want to get a taste of what awaits you in Dark Fracture, you can already try Dark Fracture: Prologue, the free introductory chapter of the game 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389160/Dark_Fracture_Prologue/

notes.title: 8 Facts the Church doesn't want you to know about
notes.notes:
One Shell Straight to Hell is a roguelite top-down shooter about being a badass priest and sweeping demons out of this world, but there’s more to that!

While we are approaching the release date, here are 8 curiosities about the development of One Shell Straight to Hell – some of them might sound a bit crazy but are totally real!

[u][b]Fact #1 – The Padre’s Order is named after a real pope
[/b][/u]
The Society of Honorius III is named after a mediaeval pope, Honorius III, who is purported to have authored a grimoire which was specifically designed to be used by priests. In the text, he supposedly discusses how a Christian priest can summon and control evil spirits. It is almost certain that Honorius himself did not author any such book, as it would have been a gross and public violation of Christian teachings (and, as we know, popes used to be posthumously tried in courts for less).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895754/4700d7098f707e41d8d2b0a4d2060648dd568691.jpg[/img]
[i]A portrait of Pope Honorius III by artist Leandro Bassano[/i]

[b][u]#2 – The voice of Padre belongs to an English lecturer, author, and editor[/u][/b]

The Padre’s unique voice is delivered by Patrick Hickey Jr. who, you may be surprised to learn, is a full-time lecturer of English and assistant director of the journalism program at Kingsborough Community College. Patrick is also the founder and editor-in-chief of ReviewFix.com - a place where you can find gaming and pop culture news and reviews. In 2018 he wrote a book entitled The Minds Behind the Games: Interviews With Cult And Classic Video Game Developers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895754/b86a16f67ed604e8ef7b7336faa285fede8306ba.jpg[/img]
[i]The cover of Patrick Hickery Jr's book 'The Mind Behind the Games'[/i]

[u][b]#3 – The Padre’s back story and parts of the script were written by a priest  [/b][/u]

The backstory and characters’ biographies were crafted by our story consultant, Reverend James White. When not serving the needs of his parish in England, Reverend James writes about video games and fantasy books. You can also find him playing and running RPGs - to our surprise not as a Cleric but as a Wizard! Without his craft, the world of Padre would not be the same.

[u][b]#4 – One Shell Straight to Hell differs greatly from its predecessor[/b][/u]

If you are reading this on The Padre community hub, you most likely already realized that the first game starring Padre was a voxel art puzzle-based game. Although the game's acclaim didn’t translate to blockbuster numbers, the foundations had been laid for an epic sequel. Now Padre returns to the forefront of the battlefield between good and evil. Once again the player will don the cloth to vanquish evil with harsh sermons and sharp wit, but this time with a whole lot of bullets as well.

[u][b] #5 – One Shell Straight to Hell was inspired by Poland’s best-selling magazine about exorcisms.[/b][/u]

The idea for the return of Padre in One Shell Straight to Hell came to be on a rainy day in early 2019 in Feardemic’s hometown, Kraków, Poland. The concept of priests banishing demons through exorcism is a popular one in Poland. It is popular to such an extent that the country even boasts its own magazine specifically about the art of exorcism called “Egzorcysta”. On that rainy day, one of the 15,000 copies of the monthly edition of the magazine found its way into Feardemic’s office and influenced the staff of both Feardemic and Shotgun with Glitters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895754/4c246e5acd947e5e081dddeea093292d5ff71327.jpg[/img]
[i]Cover from March 2014 issue of ‘Egzorcysta’[/i]

[u][b]#6 – Padre is drawn by one of Hungary’s best up-and-coming artists [/b][/u]

The character of Padre was drawn by one of Hungary’s most talented artists - Keve Kepes. Ever since he learnt to hold a pencil, he has been drawing characters from game worlds, working away toward the creation of the perfect protagonist. Back in 2018, Keve was asked to reimagine Padre and to create a universe where demons and the Church battle for moral authority. It was his work that became the real driver in shaping the world of the game and the characters you encounter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37895754/dde810b607380af7d0a5791b56f7639ddb0f2271.jpg[/img]
[i]An artwork of Keve Kepes[/i]

[u][b] #7 – The sisters who took Padre in as a boy are REAL [/b][/u]

In the final episode of The Archiver, we discover that Padre as a child was found on the steps of St Jude's Catholic Orphanage where he was taken in and raised by the Sisters of Our Lady of Mercy. This congregation was founded in Warsaw, Poland on November 1st, 1862. Their “Houses of Mercy” can still be found in Poland as well as in other countries.

[u][b] #8 – The story consultant was actually part of a real church Paranormal Investigation 
[/b][/u]
Although Reverend James White does not recall performing nor witnessing an exorcism performed with consecrated ammunition, he was called upon to investigate a report of a 21st-century haunting. Despite the fact that the details of it are too chilling to recount here, services of an exorcist were actually not required. There was however some furniture involved, which may have influenced some of the uncomfortable welcoming committees in One Shell Straight to Hell. 



[i][b]Reminder[/b]: One Shell Straight to Hell will be released on the 9th of February 2021 – wishlist the game and tell your friends![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330370/One_Shell_Straight_to_Hell/

notes.title: Procedural world generation in One Shell Straight to Hell
notes.notes:
One of the key aspects of every roguelite game is, unarguably, the possibility to enjoy a different experience at each playthrough. 

On top of offering dozens of weapons and abilities, The Padre's sequel, One Shell Straight to Hell, doubles down on variety by using procedural generation to change the levels at every playthrough — [b]each level map has more than a 1.000.000 possible variations[/b], making it virtually impossible to visit the exact same location twice.

Check out an example of this in our latest trailer:
[previewyoutube=PORyqrbgj2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]Reminder[/b]: One Shell Straight to Hell will be released on the 9th of February 2021 – wishlist the game and tell your friends![/i]

notes.title: DARQ: Complete Edition is HERE!
notes.notes:
Our friendly dev team Unfold Games has just released their award-winning game [b][i]DARQ[/i][/b] with a little extra on top. Apart from the original game, [b][i]DARQ: Complete Edition[/i][/b] contains two DLCs, including The Crypt, which is available to play today for the first time. 

If you already own the original DARQ, you can download both DLCs, [i][b]The Tower[/b][/i] and [b][i]The Crypt[/i][/b], for free.

While we know this news is not directly related to The Padre, we wanted to share it with you since we’re pretty sure that if you are interested in  The Padre, you’ll enjoy DARQ too!

Curious what awaits you in [b][i]DARQ[/i][/b]? Let us give you a little sneak peek:

[b][i]DARQ[/i][/b] will take you on a journey through a boy's dreams that quickly turn into a loop of nightmares. Lloyd, the main character, is trying to wake up, but unfortunately, each attempt sinks him deeper into his lucid subconscious-driven dreams. Lloyd has to adapt to the new world, re-learn gravity, and strain his mind and all of his senses in order to solve puzzles and sneak past the creatures guarding the shadowy corners of DARQ.

Sounds fascinating, doesn’t it?

notes.title: A Note from the Desk of Padre Alexander
notes.notes:
[b]A Note from the Desk of Padre Alexander[/b]

The end of year is often associated with the giving of gifts but it’s also a time where we reflect on the year that was. 

In my case it seems like a whirlwind of demon slaying and exorcising a right buffet of demons from the flocks most vulnerable!  

It’s also been a time to reflect on how I help in other ways and what it means to be a world-famous demon hunting priest. 

My show [b][i]Dear Padre[/i][/b] is a way that I can reach out to a great many of my flock through the power of network television. Broadcast daily on the Vatican Network, [i][b]Dear Padre[/b][/i] is one of the most loved shows in Vatican City and the Popes personal favorite, or so I am told.  I thought I would share an episode with you here:

[previewyoutube=xV4hF4Ta_Lw;full][/previewyoutube]

Another of my passions is providing advisory to the many diocese in regard to the holy sacrament and this case (no pun included) - I reach out via my weekly wine show on the Vatican Network called [i][b]Padre’s Wine Library[/b][/i].  It's essential viewing for those wondering what tipple to sample over the long lonely weekend evenings. 

[previewyoutube=H35t9AgD0AA;full][/previewyoutube]

So, no matter what demons are stalking you, I have a solution for all – just remember when the devil calls you, you can call me. 

Padre Alexander

notes.title: The Padre is here to save your Soul
notes.notes:
It has been a long and stressful road for us. Countless mugs of coffee and unslept nights later we can finally say it out loud – We’ve done it! The Padre is coming out worldwide and multiplatform! We’ve dreamt about this day for months and we cannot wait how it will be received by media, but most importantly by the wonderful community of video game enthusiasts out there. 

The project grew from our love of retro games, genres that for most have been long forgotten – Point and Click Adventure games and the beginnings of the Horror Adventure genre. This is why we used voxel graphics (or if you prefer a less technical term 3D Pixel Art), filled the game with easter eggs and made the protagonist a witty smart-ass taking us back to the golden age of action films. Of course, we left out some gameplay anachronisms that would make the game less-enjoyable but we preserved the aesthetic and feel as much as it was humanly possible.

The IDDQD code is no longer necessary, we’re leaving god mode off and the rest is up to you. We hope you will enjoy playing The Padre as much as we adored creating it.

Shotgun With Glitters Team

notes.title: The highly anticipated moment has finally come – The Padre will be releasing April 18th!
notes.notes:
Before we go into any details, we wanted to[b] thank each and everyone who has supported the Padre[/b] in its Early Access period. You guys are the reason why we decided to develop games! 

Now let’s move to some details:

[b]What has changed since the last Early Access update?[/b]
- New story elements and new scenes
- Extended end game
- New cut scenes
- Melee and ranged combat reformed. It is much more convenient and straightforward now.
- New inventory and UI
- New music, voices, and voiceover elements
- Controller support redesigned
- Improved AI

[b]Important note: [/b]The changes were so extensive that the previous saved games will not be working in the new version. We could not keep the consistency with the previous version.
Please start the story from the beginning to see every little addition. Thanks for your patience!

With the final release we will be upping the price to 19,99 USD/EUR. Those of you who have the Early Access version bought fret not! You don’t need to pay a dime for this update. We strongly recommend though you run the game again and see how the story of our demon slaying Padre has been improved.

We hope the updated version will bring you hours of entertainment that will stay with you for a while. Please enjoy the game!
-	Shotgun With Glitters

[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]French
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[/list]

[b]Death/Sin - Resurrection/Redemption system[/b]
There was no penalty of your failures and sins. It has changed...

[b]Enhanced Combat[/b]
Faster melee combat and stronger weapons, but the enemies also learned new tricks to surprise you.

[b]New Weapons and Items[/b]
A crossbow and a rifle for the shooters, an old rusty machete for the slashers. You just have to find them.

[b]New scenes and puzzles[/b]
Plenty of new areas and a new fullscreen puzzle also added.

[b]New Cutscenes[/b]
When you enter a new area a quick flythrough camera helps you a bit

[b]Smaller additions[/b]
[list]
[*]New music tracks
[*]New voice lines
[*]Story changes and new elements
[*]Puzzle hint system
[*]An annoying but helpful companion on your journey
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you for all the feedback![/b] 
We were (and still are) in joy with all the kind things you guys have said about our game thus far. Rest assured, we have paid close attention to your criticism and are focused on making [b]The Padre[/b] better than ever.

Right off the bat however, we could not solve every issue, but we are determined to transform our "promising" game to a great one.

The Upcoming Changes and the Reasoning Them;
[list]
[*]We added three new rooms to the story - just because ;)
[*]Two new weapons will appear somewhere in the mansion: Based on user feedback
[*]In-game cutscenes added - We would like to make the game more movie-like, and draw you into the story, this seems to be a great tool to do that.
[*]Puzzle Hints: some of you had problems with our puzzles. We did not want to make them easier, but instead added hints to understand their mechanisms better.
[*]Zombies are more unpredictable, fast and deadly in close combat - We want to move away from close combat and make it a last resort. To be honest, it was not fun. We would like you to have fun.
[*]Some items were hidden but not intentionally. Now you can see them.
[/list]
 
As stated earlier, we are updating the game constantly, but there are a lot of things to improve. This is our first update. There are many more still to come.

We are confident that the game will slowly grow longer and overall, more fun!

And lastly, we would like to hear your voice about the changes! That’s the easiest way for us to know if we’re going in the right direction!

Till next time,

The Padre Team
